text: Updated #6573 with an isolated positive control: CSV 1.235 into N(5,2) exports as 1.24 in VFP9 but Copperfin stores 1.235 (declared scale violation). Thus same root numeric-scale conversion causes asymmetric behavior: negative -1.235 rejected for text width while positive is stored unrounded.
